basic_profile.bio: I'm Alexei, a 28-year-old tech enthusiast and cryptocurrency investor living in Moscow, Russia. By day, I work as a software developer at a fintech startup, and by night, I delve into the world of blockchain and digital currencies. My interests include gaming, especially Fortnite, and exploring new culinary techniques, particularly slow cooking. When I need a break from the screen, I enjoy reading science fiction and organizing my ever-growing bookshelf. I am currently single and typically active on Reddit during evenings and weekends, Moscow time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from a well-known Russian university and have spent the last decade immersing myself in the world of blockchain and cryptocurrencies. My knowledge comes from both formal education and extensive self-teaching through online courses, forums, and market analysis.
